title: Per-hop metering adjustment causing silent bypass and double-debit on routed requests
creator: Maya R. Thompson
description:
Summary:
We discovered a correctness bug in the rate limiting / metering pipeline that manifests when requests are routed across multiple processing hops (edge -> regional proxy -> aggregator). Under specific failover and route-remap conditions, the system both (A) records duplicate debits against a customer key (double-debit) and (B) in some severe failover races the central aggregator never receives the final debit, leading to a transient silent bypass where requests are allowed beyond quota.

Symptoms observed:
- Sudden token/usage spikes in prometheus where per-hop debit counters sum to ~2x the canonical usage.
- Intermittent request successes after reported quota exhaustion for some customers during regional failovers.
- Billing dashboard shows small groups of requests attributed to ephemeral route aliases with zero settle event.

Why this ticket:
This is high-severity (P0) because it affects customer billing accuracy and enforcement guarantees; needs a short-term mitigation, a code fix, and post-deploy reconciliation tools.

Reproduction (internal):
1) Configure an org with per-key hard quota and enable route aliasing between region-a and region-b.
2) Issue a burst of streaming generation requests that exceed the per-route burst threshold.
3) Force a simulated regional failover by killing the regional proxy in region-a while in-flight requests are mid-stream.
4) Observe prometheus metrics: rateengine.hop_debits_total{hop=\"edge\"} + rateengine.hop_debits_total{hop=\"proxy\"} > rateengine.canonical_debits_total by ~2x, and the aggregator ingestion log contains incomplete receipts for some request ids.

Initial root-cause hypothesis:
- The enforcement model currently allows per-hop provisional debits that are reconciled later by the aggregator. During failover, the aggregator receives either duplicate provisional receipts (counted twice) or no final confirmation for a subset of requests, depending on the ordering of acknowledgements and lease revocations.
- There's no robust de-duplication key when route-alias or proxy remap changes the canonical request metadata mid-flight. The system uses (request_id, hop_id) instead of a stable idempotency key tuned to end-to-end canonicalization.

Evidence collected so far:
- Sample logs: /var/log/rateengine/2026-02-18/region-a-agg.log lines with repeated debit events for request_id 6a7b2f...
- Prometheus snippets and Grafana dashboard snapshots linked below.
- Affected orgs list extracted from billing by comparing per-hop and canonical aggregates.

Temporary mitigations (short-term):
- Rollback feature flag that enabled per-hop provisional debit (flag: hop_provisional_debit=true -> false). This reduces double-count, at the expense of a small latency increase for some small-edge requests.
- Deploy rateengine-side patch to reject duplicate debit receipts arriving within 2s window based on (org, canonical_key, sequence_id) until full fix lands.

Long-term fix plan:
1) Introduce a stable end-to-end idempotency key generated at the gateway (call it x-canonical-id) and make each hop propagate it.
2) Update aggregator to dedupe on x-canonical-id and to treat per-hop provisional debits as tentative until final settlement; reconciliation proto will be explicit.
3) Add a lease/ack protocol that guarantees either final settle or an explicit cancel so the aggregator never silently omits a debit.
4) Add migration job to reconcile historical windows where provisional debits were double-counted.

Acceptance criteria for the fix:
- No double-debits observed in spike tests for three consecutive chaos runs.
- Aggregator dedupe test coverage added (unit + integration).
- Reconciliation job run and reported results show <0.005% variance against expected usage for affected windows.

Monitoring and dashboards to add:
- rateengine.dedupe_suppressed_total (counter) to surface how many duplicates are prevented.
- alert: HighDebitMismatch when sum(per-hop_debits) / canonical_debits > 1.05 for 5m.
- billing-reconciliation job dashboard showing pre/post delta per-org.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0: short-term mitigations on prod controlled by flags (already deployed to 4 regions, rolled to 50% of traffic).
- Phase 1: merge x-canonical-id propagation PR behind flag, end-to-end tests in staging (QA).
- Phase 2: enable dedupe in aggregator in canary region; monitor for 48h.
- Phase 3: full rollout + run reconciliation job + billing corrections if necessary.
